basis: train_v2_corrected (generator 2.0, non-isolated Cowrie, profiles_v2.json 2.0.0, speed 8); logged-in sessions n=1498 in 1498 interactions unless stated. Recommendations are provisional evidence for an approval decision; the specification is unchanged.

transferability.transfers_to_generator_2_1: content mechanisms (profile vocabularies L5, Cowrie output verbosity, C4 template operators) - compat profiles keep the same templates except the botnet wget target, exfiltration scp and lateral ssh steps
transferability.does_not_transfer: timing (C2), lifecycle (C3) and input-loss (L6) mechanisms - generator 2.1 removed per-profile delay_range, timer-based sending and unclosed failed logins; these features must be re-tested on a generator-2.1 training run

login_success.evidence: constant (1) in logged-in sessions; across all sessions eps2=0.18 only through the per-profile number of failed-guess sessions (brute_force 3-5 per interaction), a behavioural design, not an artefact
login_success.caveat: the session mix per category depends on credentials.failed_attempts

login_failed_count.evidence: equals 1 - login_success in 3,123/3,123 sessions (Spearman -1.0); constant 0 in logged-in sessions. Fails C1 retention evidence (|rho| < 0.95). Generator 2.1 still opens one connection per attempt, so the redundancy persists
login_failed_count.exclusion_mechanism: deactivate (patch revision); column kept in raw extraction

session_duration_s.evidence: eps2=0.80 [0.78,0.83]; single-feature BA=0.64 (chance 0.17); residual eps2 after input_line_count=0.64; every failed-only session = 120 s (pre-fix unclosed connection); per-profile delay_range drives it. Fails C3 on this evidence; the mechanisms were removed in 2.1 but the result is untested there

input_line_count.evidence: eps2=0.57 [0.54,0.61]; BA=0.43; template-driven (profiles have fixed step counts and disjoint vocabularies); botnet/lateral counts biased by generator-2.0 line loss (44% / 8% of lines lost, L6)

input_bytes_total.evidence: eps2=0.48 [0.44,0.52]; BA=0.40; fixed command strings per profile; same L6 bias

input_line_max_bytes.evidence: eps2=0.67 [0.63,0.71]; highest single-feature BA=0.77; exact-value lookup correct for 82% of sessions; missingness (no input) Cramer's V=0.67

unique_command_names.evidence: eps2=0.57; Spearman 0.96 with input_line_count; command-name sets never shared across categories

shell_operator_lines.evidence: non-zero only in privilege_escalation (85%; the '2>/dev/null' redirect in its find templates); fails C4 (b) (non-zero in >= 2 categories)
shell_operator_lines.exclusion_mechanism: broaden/overlap profile vocabularies and regenerate, else deactivate

download_command_lines.evidence: exactly 1 in every botnet session, 0 elsewhere (eps2=1.0): a single-category indicator; fails C4 (b) and (c). Under compat profiles only botnet and the held-out exfiltration profile download
download_command_lines.exclusion_mechanism: broaden/overlap profile vocabularies and regenerate, else deactivate

time_to_first_input_s.evidence: values carry no category information (eps2=0.003; median 0.0997 s in every category = generator-2.0 fixed 0.0625 s wait + latency): fails C2 (c) 'not near-constant'. Category information only through missingness (no input; Cramer's V=0.67). Generator 2.1 draws it from the shared policy - untested

inter_input_mean_s.decision: Exclude on current evidence; re-test on generator 2.1
inter_input_mean_s.evidence: eps2=0.79 [0.77,0.81]; BA=0.66; Spearman 0.88 with the profile delay_range midpoint (generator-2.0 pacing); missingness V=0.99; Spearman 0.86 with session_duration_s

inter_input_std_s.decision: Exclude on current evidence; re-test on generator 2.1
inter_input_std_s.evidence: eps2=0.41 [0.36,0.45]; BA=0.52; same pacing mechanism; missingness V=0.84

tty_output_bytes.evidence: eps2=0.60 [0.56,0.63]; BA=0.51; residual eps2 after input_bytes_total=0.42 -> category information beyond input volume from Cowrie's per-command output verbosity (fixed templates x emulation); brute_force output outside other categories' range for 84%
